description: This file defines an Android IntentService named DeleteService, responsible for handling delete operations on calendar event data items via the Wearable DataApi. It manages GoogleApiClient connections, performs delete requests, and shows confirmation animations based on operation success or failure.

classes.name: DeleteService
classes.description: An IntentService that handles deletion of data items on Android Wear devices, using GoogleApiClient to communicate with the DataApi and providing visual confirmation via animations.

methods.name: DeleteService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service with its class name.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes GoogleApiClient with Wearable API and connection callbacks.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Performs data item deletion via GoogleApiClient, shows success or failure confirmation animations, and handles connection issues.

methods.name: startConfirmationActivity
methods.description: Starts a ConfirmationActivity with specified animation and message.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Logs failure to connect to GoogleApiClient.
